receiver_reference.notes: Rough open fork, not a modeled capture actuator; height control changes fork geometry and placement, independently of mouthWidth.

cradle.notes: Straight V trough, nominal tangent contact; router stock/travel and split construction require review.

transfer_ramp.notes: V2 lower-profile 390 mm wide flat polycarbonate transfer surface with separate foot blocks; no bend or bumper notch. Entry top Z=320 mm; pickup belt crest Z=440 mm. The 120 mm gravity drop and capture dynamics are UNVERIFIED, not a transfer success claim.

hex_bearing_envelope.notes: WCP-0783 nominal body only. Flange/races/loads pending. Whole envelope follows inner hex; circular OD does not imply race locking.

x44_envelope.notes: WCP-0941 body 47.4 x 75; 8 mm cylindrical spline envelope. Shaft extension assumed 22 mm; catalog drawing confirmation required.

pinion_16_envelope.notes: 16 teeth, 20 DP, 14.5 deg; teeth omitted, addendum envelope. Assumed face width 8 mm, NOT vendor gear geometry.

gear_48_envelope.notes: 48 teeth, 20 DP, 14.5 deg. Simplified solid addendum envelope; actual WCP width/retention pending.

orienter_hex_shaft.notes: 1/2 inch AF native interface; collars/axial retention in omitted hardware BOM.

orienter_contact_drum.notes: Custom 70 mm OD contact drum, not AndyMark am-3462. Tire compliance/friction and hub construction unverified.

orienter_housing.notes: One printable U support plus open-bottom gear side guards; no precision bend. Motor clocking and top access guard still require vendor and safety review.

pickup_cross_tube.notes: 20 x 20 x 2 metric tube; end fasteners omitted, end holes pending.

pivot_spine.notes: Fixed 1/2 inch hex spine supports independent frame and upper-drum bearings; separate frame/drum outer races.

upper_pickup_drum.notes: Continuous bored tube with end bearing seats. Rubber/hub retention and stiffness pending.

lower_pickup_drum.notes: Hex-driven lower drum and end hubs treated as one rigid custom part; detailed hub build pending.

pickup_belt.notes: Actual closed 3 mm belt envelope with two tangent spans and wrap. Flexible belt represented fixed for clearance only, not a rigid native transmission simulation.

pickup_output_gear.notes: Custom 96t gear with bearing-clearance hub; 6:1 reduction, teeth simplified to addendum envelope. Bolted drum flange retention pending.

pickup_gear_guard.notes: V2 radial relief: 23 mm inner radius exceeds 17.4625 mm bolt-circle radius plus 4.5 mm standoff radius by 1.0375 mm. Side cover and attachment remain unverified.

pivot_tower.notes: Flat tower with machined/bolted foot represented as a rigid contiguous module; joining and spine clamp hardware pending.

deploy_output_gear.notes: Custom 96t output, 20 DP/14.5 deg, 6:1 mesh at 71.12 mm centers; 4 M4 bolt pattern to left carrier. Axial hub shortens under mouth revision.

deploy_support_module.notes: Flat tower plus two 6 mm gearbox cheeks, four turned spacers and a bolted bridge, represented as one rigid module. No bending. Plates are at world X=-333/-307; 1/2-inch hex bearing centers Y=171.12,Z=410; motor at Y=262.56,Z=410. Joining bolt lengths/stock grade and cheek bending are UNVERIFIED_BUILD.

deploy_compound_shaft_module.notes: 128t driven gear, 64 mm long 1/2-inch hex shaft and 16t final pinion, joined as one rigid module, NOT one purchasable box. Gear centers share Y=171.12,Z=410; faces at X=-318 and -281. Disks are addendum envelopes, NOT cuttable involute teeth. Three physical items plus retention; exact broach/key, tooth form, joining and load rating UNVERIFIED_BUILD.
